openQuestions: Do Amazon.com, BestBuy.com and Newegg.com transactions reliably code as 'U.S. online retail purchases' for the Blue Cash Everyday 3% and Hilton Surpass 4% categories? Terms say Amex relies on merchant info; marketplace/third-party-seller orders on Amazon and Newegg and BOPIS orders at Best Buy are excluded or uncertain.

Gold Card 5X on prepaid hotels via Amex Travel and Hilton Surpass 4X online retail look like 2025-26 changes; exact effective dates and whether existing cardholders got them at the same time were not found on official pages.

Membership Rewards cash value: the issuer calculator shows 0.6 cents (statement credit) vs 0.7 cents (Pay with Points at Amazon/Best Buy checkout) for a Platinum card; values may differ by card and change over time. Also Surpass annual fee: fee table says $150 but product page advertises $0 intro first year (offer-dependent).
Rates were read from offer pages linked from the product pages (prospect/terms with eep 25330 or 25201); other eep or offerTrackingCode variants may show different welcome offers or intro fees.
